summary: First-finish smoke tests on StudyFlow (backend + frontend) using demo account demo@studyflow.it. All critical backend endpoints and the main FE flow (landing -> demo login -> home -> esami -> piano -> progressi) work end-to-end. AI-powered plan generation and chat both return real Italian AI content via Claude/emergentintegrations. Auth isolation verified.
passed: POST /api/auth/login demo creds -> 200, JWT token (188 chars)
GET /api/exams -> 3 seeded exams (Analisi Matematica II, Basi di Dati, Reti di Calcolatori)
GET /api/progress -> week_planned_hours=22.5, daily array len=7, exams len=3
POST /api/chat -> Italian AI reply referencing user's exam (Analisi Matematica II, 12 giorni)
Auth isolation: new signup user sees 0 exams (does not see demo user's data)
FE Landing loads with StudyFlow brand + demo button; demo autofill+submit works

FE Home shows greeting 'Buongiorno Giulia', prossimo esame card (Analisi Matematica II, 12 giorni, 37%), today plan with tasks (Teoria/Esercizi/Ripasso), 'Sono rimasto indietro' button (data-testid=fell-behind-button) present
FE /esami lists all 3 exams with difficulty badges, days-remaining, prep progress bars, Modifica/Elimina, Aggiungi, and 'Genera piano di studio con AI' button
FE sidebar navigation nav-item-esami/piano/progressi routes correctly

warnings.issue: Recharts prints 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warning on initial mount (likely first-paint sizing race). Chart still renders after resize.

action_items: Optional: wrap Progress page BarChart in a container with explicit min-height to silence recharts sizing warning.
notes: Task PUT response is {ok:true} (not full task object) — FE reloads tasks after update so this is fine. Backend requires field names exam_date and estimated_hours (matches ExamModal.jsx). Replan endpoint requires a JSON body (FE sends {reason:...}).
